grammar_focus: KS1/25/49 简单句·并列句·复合句复习(教材 L73 Key structures):用连词把句子连成简单句/并列句/复合句——who·whose(定语)、when·as、after+分词、although·in spite of the fact that、not only...but...as well、such...that、before;辅以课文被动语态复习(was given / was picked up / wasn't noticed by anyone)与词汇辨析 evade/ashamed/imagination
scene: 逃学的孩子们都缺乏想象力。他们通常能做到的,至多也就是安静地钓上一天鱼,或在电影院里连着看上8个小时同一部电影。而有那么一个小男孩,他在逃学期间旅行了1600英里,使上述所有逃学的孩子都相形见绌。他搭便车到了多佛,天快黑时钻进了一条船,想找个地方睡觉。第二天早上他醒来时,发现船在这段时间已经到了加莱。当男孩从船里爬出来时,谁也没有发现他。从那里他又搭卡车到了巴黎。司机给了他几块饼干和一杯咖啡,就把他丢在了城外。男孩截住的下一辆车,没有像他希望的那样把他带到巴黎市中心,而是把他带到了法国和西班牙边界上的佩皮尼昂。他在那儿被一个警察抓住了,之后被当局送回了英国。他无疑为成千上万梦想逃避上学的孩子们创造了一项纪录。

grammar_card.title: KS1/25/49 简单句·并列句·复合句复习
grammar_card.intro: 本课复习“用连词把几句话连成一句”:①who/whose——把“人”和对他的描述连起来(a boy who traveled 1,600 miles;the man whose book was published);②when/as——“当…时”(When he woke up… / as he crept off);③after + 分词——“被…之后”(After being picked up…);④although / in spite of the fact that——“尽管”;⑤not only…but…as well——“不仅…而且”;⑥such…that——“如此…以致”;⑦before——“在…之前”。另配课文被动复习:was given / was picked up / wasn't noticed by anyone。

rows: 连接人与描述:a boy who traveled 1,600 miles
表时间:When he woke up… / as he crept off
although / in spite of the fact that
表尽管:Although the police searched everywhere…
表递进:not only reached the top but spent the night as well
such a fright that… / before help arrived

specialRules.rule: 美语里“卡车”说 truck(英式 lorry)、“饼干”说 cookie(英式 biscuit)、“电影院”说 movie theater(英式 cinema)、“电影”说 movie(英式 film);本课已按美语改写课文。
词汇辨析:evade=逃避、逃离(=escape);ashamed=感到羞愧(shameful=可耻的,修饰事);imagination=想象力(名词)。

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — Did the boy go where he wanted to?
options: No — he wanted the center of Paris but ended up at Perpignan on the border
Yes — he reached the center of Paris

passage: Children who play truant from school are unimaginative. A quiet day's fishing, or eight hours in a movie theater seeing the same movie over and over again, is usually as far as they get. They have all been put to shame by a boy who, while playing truant, traveled 1,600 miles. He hitchhiked to Dover and, toward evening, went into a boat to find somewhere to sleep. When he woke up next morning, he discovered that the boat had, in the meantime, traveled to Calais. No one noticed the boy as he crept off. From there, he hitchhiked to Paris in a truck. The driver gave him a few cookies and a cup of coffee and left him just outside the city. The next car the boy stopped did not take him into the center of Paris as he hoped it would, but to Perpignan on the French-Spanish border. There he was picked up by a policeman and sent back to England by the local authorities. He has surely set up a record for the thousands of children who dream of evading school.

stage5.stem: "No one noticed the boy ___ he crept off the boat."(“正当…时”的连词)
stage5.stem_cn: 男孩溜下船时,没人注意到他。

stage5.stem: "___ picked up by a policeman, he was sent back to England."(用“被…之后”的分词短语开头)

stage5.stem: "___ the police searched everywhere, the missing boy could not be found."(“尽管”的让步连词)
stage5.stem_cn: 尽管警察到处搜寻,还是找不到那个失踪的男孩。

stage5.stem: "In spite of the fact ___ fares have increased, the company is still losing money."(引出后面的说明内容)
stage5.stem_cn: 尽管票价上涨,公司仍在亏损。

stage5.stem: "___ very tired, he kept on walking."(“尽管…”的让步连词,后接形容词)
stage5.stem_cn: 尽管很累,他还是继续往前走。

stage5.stem: "The climbers ___ reached the top but spent the night there as well."(“不仅…而且”的前半)

stage5.stem: "He gave me ___ a fright that I knocked the teapot over."(“如此…以致”:接名词短语用哪个词)
stage5.stem_cn: 他把我吓了一大跳,我把茶壶都碰翻了。

stage5.stem: "He fought the wolves off for three hours ___ help arrived."(“在…之前”的时间连词)

stage5.stem: "The boy ___ a few cookies by the driver."(被动:被给了几块饼干)

stage5.stem: "He crept off the boat and ___ by anyone."(否定被动:没被任何人注意到)
stage5.stem_cn: 他溜下了船,没被任何人注意到。

stage5.stem: "Thousands of children dream of ___ school."(逃避、逃学用哪个词)

stage5.stem: "They have been put to shame; they should feel ___."(感到羞愧用哪个词)
